method: curl via agent proxy, UA CartoucheSourceSurvey/1.0, 2s delay; ~65 requests. Listing tables parsed from static HTML (WordPress + DataTables client-side; all rows are in the HTML, no server pagination).

sources.listing_structure: Single HTML table (title | size | Pays | Année), newest first, no pagination. Country column values inconsistent (Cameroun/CAMEROUN/Cameoun, RCA/Centrafrique, Guinée Eqquatoriale...).
sources.naming_pattern: Highly inconsistent, no stable scheme. Examples: 'Communiqué-des-résultats-BTA-26-semaines-du-15-septembre-2026.pdf' (COG), 'COMMUNIQUE-DES-RESULTATS-DE-LEMISSION-DES-OTA-3-ANS_14-SEPT-2026_TRESOR-DU-CAMEROUN.pdf', 'Communiqué-des-résultats-BTA-13S-220726_GA1100002292.pdf' (GAB, ISIN in name), 'Communique-des-resultats-definitifs-CM1300000872-BTA-52-20-MAI-2026.pdf'. Upload folder often reused (2016/11) so path date != publication date. Some GNQ docs also in Spanish, some CMR in English.
sources.history_oldest: 2019 (Année column; earliest results e.g. 'Communiqué-des-résultats-BTA-Gabon_05-06-2019.pdf', upload dir 2019/02)
sources.history_newest: Results for auctions of 14-15 Sep 2026 (CMR/CAF/COG, signed 16-18 Sep 2026); announcements for 21-22 Sep 2026
sources.cadence: Weekly auctions per country; documents posted irregularly, within days of the auction. Coverage NOT exhaustive (very few results listed for 2022-2023) - treat as partial.

fields_available.issuer_country: yes (letterhead + ISIN prefix CM/CF/TD/CG/GQ?/GA; table column 'Pays' on listing page)
fields_available.tenor_maturity: yes (maturity date in code line, e.g. '18-MARS-2027'); OTA coupon in code line
fields_available.amount_offered: yes ('Montant annoncé par le Trésor', millions FCFA)
fields_available.marginal_rate_or_price: yes ('Taux limite' for BTA; 'Prix limite' for OTA)
fields_available.weighted_average: yes ('Taux moyen pondéré' BTA / 'Prix moyen pondéré' OTA); CMR also prints 'Taux de rendement'
fields_available.number_of_bidders: yes ('Nombre de SVT soumissionnaires' + 'Nombre de SVT du réseau')
fields_available.settlement_date: NO on result communiqués; present on announcement communiqués ('Date de règlement', 'Date de valeur') and on the weekly 'Tableau de bord' (dates d'opérations / dates de règlement) - join by ISIN

sources.text_or_scanned: SCANNED. All 13 sampled result/announcement PDFs are page images (HP Scan, Canon, Xerox, CamScanner, Genius Scan). 2026 COG/CMR/CAF/GAB samples have no text layer at all. Some (TCD 2023/2026, CMR 2020, GAB 2022, CAF 2021) carry a scanner OCR layer that is noisy (e.g. '6,007o' for 6,00%, 'ls 000' for 15 000, 'I9' for 19) -> unusable without re-OCR + strict validation. NEEDS OCR (tesseract/ocrmypdf not installed in this env).
sources.layout_notes: Single-auction communiqué, 1-2 pages, one 'Code Emission' block per line (CAF puts 2 lines on one page in bordered table). Labels are very stable across countries ('Nombre de SVT du réseau', 'Montant annoncé...', 'Montant total servi', 'Taux/Prix limite', 'Taux/Prix moyen pondéré', 'Taux de couverture') -> label-anchored OCR parsing feasible. Values in millions FCFA, French decimals.
sources.data_quality_flag: GAB OTA 10y 16 Mar 2022 scanner-OCR text reads 'Prix Moyen Pondéré : 93,1662%' while max price proposed is 90,0000% - either a source error or an OCR error (not verified against image); illustrates need for the strict checker (min<=avg<=max, servi<=soumissions).
